b: I don't know if this is true burn-out or laziness, but at some point two years ago I stopped being able to work for an extended period of time. I still had my full time job but that alone was enough to overwhelm me, which meant I couldn't work on my business after work and I stopped doing anything to progress it.

I'm 25 now and I used to be able to work a part time job and study engineering and edit content for a flat rate for my youtuber friend when I was in uni around 18-22. one day however in the end of 2023 I graduated uni by then and was working fulltime and was working on making a game, I remember after being done for the day I tried to go to sleep but for some reason I felt like I was going to pass out then my heart rate shot up and this was my first ever panic attack.

after having it I decided to lessen the load on myself and kept only to my fulltime job, I thought if I took a year rest I would be able to work on my game later when my nervous system calmed down. and so in 2024 in August I went back to working on my game, but after only 5 months and in the beginning of 2025 I started having panic attacks again and was diagnosed with a panic disorder. so again I stopped working my project and till now I still haven't done it.
the problem is that I really want to go back to my project but I get overwhelmed almost instantly and can't work at all.
